protocols.description: Use the recovered components to overload the root network and permanently cut the town away from the organism. The response is shorter, violent, and focused on the Heartforge.
protocols.ending: The signal collapses. Organisms remain in the streets, but the intelligence coordinating them is gone. The machines inherit a wounded, survivable town.

protocols.description: Build a resonant lattice that cages the root signal without destroying the ecology. The process is longer and requires more material, but the final pressure rises more gradually.
protocols.ending: The lattice closes around the signal. The hostile ecology becomes local, animal, and finite. The Heartforge survives as the centre of a machine sanctuary rather than a conquering empire.
